notes: Symbol presence is not behavioral completion. Driver 187 on gfx1201 passed persistent queues, wraparound, multi-producer submission, two-process sharing and concurrent shader/CP/CPU-HSA signals. Driver 189 passed public coarse/kernarg pools, 64-CU topology and 100 MHz ATOM timestamp queries on hardware. Driver 190 corrected scratch wave-size units and passed two-queue scratch/LDS data/guard checks through allocation, growth and reuse. The actual pinned HRX dylib builds with an explicit macOS host-AQL adapter. Actual HRX initialization, streams, 64 KiB copy/fill, 4093-result FP32 affine and 16x16 FP32 matmul passed with exact guarded readbacks and shutdown on driver190. Model inference remains unverified. Native CPU/GPU additions and CAS contention are separate bounded experiments; no general fine-grained atomic capability is advertised. See API_STATUS.md and docs/HRX_MACOS_VALIDATION.md.
